title: Lost Exchange — buy pulls FIRST
description: Spend Lost Pieces before reset. Priority: Solid Dice → Fabricated Dice → Tri-Keys. Never buy Fons here.

title: Warp Exchange decision
description: No reset, but review monthly. 720 Warp Pieces = 1 standard char OR 30 Limited pulls OR 120k Fons per pull-equivalent.
rewards: Standard char OR pulls OR Fons

title: Arc Selection Shop (25 Tri-Keys = any S-Arc)
description: Refreshes monthly. Direct buy any S-Class Arc for 25 Tri-Keys — never roll the Arc banner blind.

title: Hunter Exchange (Fons → Annulith)
description: Unlocks via Tycoon level. Only use after Fons income is stable.

title: Beyond the Rails — clear before patch
description: Special Routes rotate with each version. Claim all Platform Seal Annulith before maintenance.

title: Pink Paws Heist — 2nd biweekly cycle
description: ~2 cycles per month. Track in-game cap counter to know when it resets.
